title: Post-adoption behavior analysis: An empirical study of the expectation confirmation model on Sharia mobile banking in Indonesia
core_idea: Investigate the drivers of continued use of Islamic (Sharia) mobile banking in Indonesia by integrating religiosity and digital literacy as external factors into the expectation confirmation model (ECM), using a quantitative survey and PLS-SEM analysis.
tldr: Extend the ECM to Islamic mobile banking to assess how religiosity and digital literacy relate to user satisfaction and continuance intention in Indonesia; empirical approach via purposive survey (505 users) and PLS-SEM.
